text: RESULTS: Brain MRI: Atrophy of the caudate nuclei with ex vacuo dilatation of the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles. Genetic Testing: Positive for the huntingtin (HTT) gene mutation. speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI findings of caudate atrophy, combined with the positive genetic test for the HTT mutation and your clinical symptoms of chorea and cognitive decline, confirm the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Huntington's Disease.
